Ramayana: Part 1 made over ₹100 crore net in India on Monday 9 November, the day after Diwali and its fifth day in cinemas. Bollywood Hungama puts the day at ₹103.47 crore net; Sacnilk's early estimate is ₹107.50 crore net. Both trackers show it as the film's first ₹100 crore day.

The Hindi version brought in most of Monday's total: ₹85.20 crore net (Bollywood Hungama), ₹87.25 crore net (Sacnilk early estimate). India net after five days: ₹333.79 crore (Bollywood Hungama), ₹346.35 crore (Sacnilk early estimate). Trackers' figures differ and can be revised.
